target.role: Grand-Place Hotel de Ville landmark mass

facts: The Grand-Place-facing gothic wings and tower are described as having white-stone facades.
The restoration history identifies Gobertange and Euville stone among exterior facade stones.

identity_note: The shipped 1655673 LoD2 mass is the dominant 93.024 m Grand-Place tower block at the locked control point; the material cue is applied only because its source geometry/location correspond to the officially inventoried Hotel de Ville.
